title: Claude Code LSP server configuration (.lsp.json)
description: Language-server configuration for a Claude Code plugin: the contents of .lsp.json at the plugin root, a map of server name to server config with no wrapper object. The same map is accepted inline as plugin.json's lspServers (plugin-manifest-schema defines that map once, and this file points to it).
$comment: Entry point for a plugin's .lsp.json: the same server map as inline lspServers in plugin.json, defined once in plugin-manifest-schema.
x-cli-unknown-keys: rejects (a top-level key is a server name; a non-object value invalidates the file)
